newsitem.title: USA: Industry jobs still growing moderately - Phila Fed.
newsitem.headline: Industry jobs still growing moderately - Phila Fed.

text.p: Manufacturing jobs are continuing to grow moderately in the third U.S. economic district, a regional economist at the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia said.
"We continue to see some moderate growth in manufacturing employment in our district," Michael Trebing, regional economist at the Philadelphia Fed, told reporters.

Trebing spoke to reporters in a conference call shortly after the release of the Philadelphia Fed's business outlook survey for the month of June. The business activity index jumped sharply to 25.2 in June against a 1.6 reading in May.

Trebing also said he sees some continued underlying strength in regional demand. "On balance what (the numbers) are saying is that there is still underlying strength in demand and output," Trebing said.
The Philadelphia Fed serves the country's third economic regional, which encompasses Delaware, the eastern region of Pennsylvania and the sourthern portion of New Jersey.
